NASB.1: 'For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace; and all the arrogant and every evildoer will be chaff; and the day that is coming will set them ablaze,' says the LORD of hosts, 'so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.'
NASB.2: 'But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings; and you will go forth and skip about like calves from the stall.
NASB.3: 'You will tread down the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day which I am preparing,' says the LORD of hosts.
NASB.4: 'Remember the law of Moses My servant, [even the] statutes and ordinances which I commanded him in Horeb for all Israel.
NASB.5: 'Behold, I am going to send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and terrible day of the LORD.
NASB.6: 'He will restore the hearts of the fathers to [their] children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, so that I will not come and smite the land with a curse.'

NKJV.1: “For behold, the day is coming, Burning like an oven, And all the proud, yes, all who do wickedly will be stubble. And the day which is coming shall burn them up,” Says the LORD of hosts, “That will leave them neither root nor branch.
NKJV.2: But to you who fear My name The Sun of Righteousness shall arise With healing in His wings; And you shall go out And grow fat like stall-fed calves.
NKJV.3: You shall trample the wicked, For they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet On the day that I do this,” Says the LORD of hosts.
NKJV.4: “Remember the Law of Moses, My servant, Which I commanded him in Horeb for all Israel, With the statutes and judgments.
NKJV.5: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet  Before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.
NKJV.6: And he will turn The hearts of the fathers to the children, And the hearts of the children to their fathers, Lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

ESV.1: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like an oven, when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be stubble. The day that is coming shall set them ablaze, says the LORD of hosts, so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

ESV.4: “Remember the law of my servant Moses, the statutes and rules  that I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel.
ESV.5: “Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and awesome day of the LORD comes.
ESV.6: And he will turn the hearts of fathers to their children and the hearts of children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the land with a decree of utter destruction.”

AMP.1: "For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, and all the arrogant (proud, self-righteous, haughty), and every evildoer shall be stubble; and the day that is coming shall set them on fire," says the LORD of hosts, "so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

AMP.3: You will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day that I do this," says the LORD of hosts.
AMP.4: "Remember [with thoughtful concern] the Law of Moses My servant, the statutes and the ordinances which I commanded him on [Mount] Horeb [to give] to all Israel.
AMP.5: "Behold, I am going to send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and terrible day of the LORD.
AMP.6: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers [a reconciliation produced by repentance], so that I will not come and strike the land with a curse [of complete destruction]."

WEB.1: “For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble; and the day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
WEB.2: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap like calves of the stall.
WEB.3: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.
WEB.4: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
WEB.5: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
WEB.6: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

NLT.1: The LORD of Heaven’s Armies says, “The day of judgment is coming, burning like a furnace. On that day the arrogant and the wicked will be burned up like straw. They will be consumed — roots, branches, and all.
NLT.2: “But for you who fear my name, the Sun of Righteousness will rise with healing in his wings. And you will go free, leaping with joy like calves let out to pasture.
NLT.3: On the day when I act, you will tread upon the wicked as if they were dust under your feet,” says the LORD of Heaven’s Armies.
NLT.4: “Remember to obey the Law of Moses, my servant — all the decrees and regulations that I gave him on Mount Sinai for all Israel.
NLT.5: “Look, I am sending you the prophet Elijah before the great and dreadful day of the LORD arrives.
NLT.6: His preaching will turn the hearts of fathers to their children, and the hearts of children to their fathers. Otherwise I will come and strike the land with a curse.”

MSG.1: "Count on it: The day is coming, raging like a forest fire. All the arrogant people who do evil things will be burned up like stove wood, burned to a crisp, nothing left but scorched earth and ash—a black day.
MSG.2: But for you, sunrise! The sun of righteousness will dawn on those who honor my name, healing radiating from its wings. You will be bursting with energy, like colts frisky and frolicking.
MSG.3: And you'll tromp on the wicked. They'll be nothing but ashes under your feet on that Day." God-of-the-Angel-Armies says so.
MSG.4: "Remember and keep the revelation I gave through my servant Moses, the revelation I commanded at Horeb for all Israel, all the rules and procedures for right living.
MSG.5: "But also look ahead: I'm sending Elijah the prophet to clear the way for the Big Day of God—the decisive Judgment Day!
MSG.6: He will convince parents to look after their children and children to look up to their parents. If they refuse, I'll come and put the land under a curse."

NRSVCE.2: But for you who revere my name the sun of righteousness shall rise, with healing in its wings. You shall go out leaping like calves from the stall.

NRSVCE.4: Remember the teaching of my servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances that I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel.
NRSVCE.5: Lo, I will send you the prophet Elijah before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.
NRSVCE.6: He will turn the hearts of parents to their children and the hearts of children to their parents, so that I will not come and strike the land with a curse.

NET.1: (3:19) “For indeed the day is coming, burning like a furnace, and all the arrogant evildoers will be chaff. The coming day will burn them up,” says the LORD who rules over all. “It will not leave even a root or branch.
NET.2: But for you who respect my name, the sun of vindication will rise with healing wings, and you will skip about like calves released from the stall.
NET.3: You will trample on the wicked, for they will be like ashes under the soles of your feet on the day which I am preparing,” says the LORD who rules over all.
NET.4: “Remember the law of my servant Moses, to whom at Horeb I gave rules and regulations for all Israel to obey.
NET.5: Look, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of the LORD arrives.
NET.6: He will encourage fathers and their children to return to me, so that I will not come and strike the earth with judgment.”

NIV.1:
The Day of the Lord
“Surely the day is coming; it will burn like a furnace. All the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble, and that day that is coming will set them on fire,” says the Lord Almighty. “Not a root or a branch will be left to them.
NIV.2: But for you who revere my name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings. And you will go out and leap like calves released from the stall.
NIV.3: Then you will trample down the wicked; they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day when I do these things,” says the Lord Almighty.
NIV.4: “Remember the law of my servant Moses, the decrees and laws I gave him at Horeb for all Israel.
NIV.5: “See, I will send you the prophet Elijah before that great and dreadful day of the Lord comes.
NIV.6: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers; or else I will come and strike the land with a curse.”
